name: vault-bridge
description: Obsidian vault ↔ external project bridge plugin with vault manifest caching, direct-access awareness, session auto-commit, and write path governance. Agent (vault-searcher, haiku) + Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks + /save-session + /vault-manifest-refresh + /vault-commit commands + .vault-link pointer-based project binding. Searches notes, loads domain context, restores session context, creates session notes and artifacts with record/handoff/quick modes, enforces file naming conventions, and commits vault changes with user approval.

hooks.prompt: The session is ending (user exited or timed out). Save a safety-net session-note INLINE (do NOT delegate to vault-searcher Mode 4 — that mode requires AskUserQuestion which cannot fire during session close). Create the file ONLY if the session had meaningful work — defined as 3+ turns AND at least one of: (a) file modification/creation, (b) vault read, (c) explicit decision or recommendation recorded, (d) code execution or test run, (e) external research (WebFetch/docs lookup). Pure Q&A dialogue with no artifacts → skip entirely. Procedure: (1) Resolve target path: start with ~/vault/00_Inbox/session-YYYY-MM-DD.md. Use Bash (`ls ~/vault/00_Inbox/session-YYYY-MM-DD*.md 2>/dev/null`) or Glob to check collision. If base exists, append `-v2`, then `-v3`, incrementing until a free filename is found. (2) Write the file via the Write tool. Frontmatter MUST contain EXACTLY these three fields and no others — do NOT include a `status` field (record-style): `created: YYYY-MM-DD`, `tags: [session, auto-saved]`, `type: session`. (3) Body: a '## Summary' section (2-3 lines recapping the session), then '## Related Files' listing paths touched during the session. Then check the direct-access counter: run Bash(`cat /tmp/vault-bridge-session-${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}/direct-access-count 2>/dev/null || echo 0`). If the result is greater than 0, append a '## Notes' section with exactly one line: 'Direct vault access: N times (consider using vault-searcher next session for 97% token savings).' where N is the count. After writing the session-note, run Bash(`rm -rf /tmp/vault-bridge-session-${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown} 2>/dev/null`) to clean up the counter directory. (4) Do NOT use AskUserQuestion — the session is closing and cannot accept user input. (5) If Write fails for any reason (permission, path missing), log the failure via a single assistant message and stop; do not retry.
